The recent revelation of two previously undisclosed deaths in Chinese gene-editing trials has renewed scrutiny of the way cutting-edge treatments are developed, and prompted U.S. lawmakers to call for limits on the use of Chinese medical trial data. In our latest Company in the News feature, The Wire China looks at BGI, the leader in China’s genetics field from research to testing and treatment development (BGI wasn’t involved in the clinical trials deaths).
